skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — trim the pauses, add transitions, and export as MP4 — and get edited video...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Video Editor Online — an AI-powered, cloud-based video editing tool for quick and simple edits.

- Upload video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) and describe your desired edits; AI processes and returns a ready-to-download video.
- Handles operations like trimming pauses, adding transitions, and exporting high-quality MP4s in 1–2 minutes.
- Automated setup includes token creation, cloud session management, and transparent feedback ("Connecting...", "Ready!") for users.
- Supports status/credits checks, multi-format exports, and error recovery for expired tokens or unsupported files.
- Intelligent routing of user prompts for specific actions such as upload, export, adding audio/text overlays, and timeline previews.
- Designed for content creators and students seeking fast video edits without using complex software.
